title: AndroidAPS crashes every time I enter the Omnipod tab
body:
I just upgraded to 3.0.0.1 the other day and everything seemed to work flawlessly, however suddenly whenever I turn to the Omnipod tab, AndroidAPS crashes. Every time.
I use Omnipod Eros and OrangeLink for bridge. 
Have tried restart of phone, link and ofc AndroidAPS itself. 
Tried rebuilding AndroidAPS with same result. 
Tried building another branch - DynamicISF which worked with going to the Omnipod tab without crashing, but this branch does not allow closed loop, so want to be able to use master. :) 

My logfile is attached.
[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8375271/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body:
I had similar issue but with Accu-check Combo and it was solved by selecting an option in the preferences menu.

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/1404

> I had similar issue but with Accu-check Combo and it was solved by selecting an option in the preferences menu.
> 
> #1404

What option did u select? I read the other issue u referenced, and tried switching on/off autosens feature, without any luck.
no crash in log. try dev branch
Dev branch is working for me, so closing this issue. Will try next master, when new version comes out. Thanks MilosKozak for looking into the log.
